content.title: US sues Southern California Edison, blames it for Eaton, Fairview wildfires
content.summary: (Reuters) -The U.S. government filed two lawsuits against Southern California Edison on Thursday, blaming the utility's equipment for sparking two wildfires, including the Eaton Fire in January that damaged National Forest System lands.  The lawsuits against the unit of Edison International were filed by the U.S. Department of Justice in Los Angeles federal court.  They seek more than $77 million in damages for the utility's alleged negligence, trespass by fire and violations of California public safety laws in causing the Eaton Fire and the September 2022 Fairview Fire.
